name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix federated playback when Auto fails over to a duplicate in a different container: ffmpeg was launched with the primary's -f (Matroska) while Auto served MP4 bytes, which exited 183. Mixed-container Auto items no longer stamp a single container, Auto prefers a live sibling the advertised demuxer can parse, and a failed live preflight no longer leaves a title with zero playable sources.
